sohn.title: hands free day calculator
sohn.tooltip: ‘Son’ means a ghost that causes damage. The last digit of the lunar calendar, 9 or 0, is an auspicious day when these ghosts ascend to heaven and do no harm on earth.
sohn.description: Find a good day to make important decisions such as moving, changing jobs, or getting married.
sohn.safeDesc: All movements are safe regardless of direction.
sohn.directionWarn: {dir}It is a day when there is concern about damage to the village.
sohn.directionWarnGeneric: Movement in certain directions requires caution.
